cards.backContent: có thể nạp hoặc làm đầy lại
cards.extra1: refill (v/n) — nạp lại; lần nạp lại
cards.extra2: refillable bottle — chai có thể châm đầy lại
cards.example: Using a refillable bottle can reduce plastic waste.

cards.extra2: sort into + groups/categories — phân thành các nhóm
cards.example: Students should sort rubbish before recycling it.
We can recycle paper, glass, and some types of plastic.

cards.extra1: protect / conserve natural resources — bảo vệ tài nguyên thiên nhiên

cards.backContent: sự phát thải; lượng khí thải
cards.example: Public transport can help reduce carbon emissions.
Cars emit gases that can pollute the air.
You can calculate your carbon footprint online.

cards.extra1: estimation (n) — sự ước tính; sự đánh giá
cards.example: Experts estimate how much energy a household uses.

cards.backContent: sự ước tính; sự đánh giá
cards.extra1: estimate (n/v) — sự ước tính; ước tính
cards.example: This figure is only an estimation of total energy use.

cards.backContent: chạy bằng điện; tạo ra điện
cards.example: Electric cars can reduce some types of air pollution.
Turn off electrical equipment when it is not in use.

cards.extra1: electronic device — thiết bị điện tử
cards.example: Old electronic devices should be recycled properly.

cards.extra2: electric (adj) — chạy bằng điện; electrical (adj) — liên quan đến điện
cards.example: We can save electricity by switching off unused lights.

cards.extra2: an average amount / an average household
cards.example: On average, families use more electricity in hot weather.

cards.extra1: a university professor — giáo sư đại học
cards.example: The professor explained how human activities affect the environment.
